description: Open the document /home/ga/Documents/expense_report_q1.docx. This document contains a table of quarterly expenses with empty total cells. You must: (1) Insert calculation formulas into the empty 'Q1 Total' column cells to sum the three months for each category row. (2) Insert calculation formulas into the empty 'Monthly Total' row cells to sum the categories for each month column. (3) Insert a formula for the Grand Total in the bottom-right cell. (4) Apply **bold** formatting to the entire 'Monthly Total' row (the last row). (5) Save the completed document as /home/ga/Documents/expense_report_q1_complete.docx. Note: You must use Writer's table formula feature (e.g., Table > Formula or F2), not manually type the calculated numbers.
